content:
anna_sales: New RFI from NorthPoint Health. They want a 4-week Dedicated POC, capability matrix (embeddings + chat), explicit KMS/HSM details, SOC2 evidence, and a clear overflow/fallback playbook. Uploaded their PDF: northpoint_rfi_nov2024.pdf. Need a draft tomorrow morning.
jordan_se: I'll draft the capability matrix and a short fallback paragraph. Quick Q for perf: recommend 2x A10 baseline for POC unless they insist on higher burst capacity.
maria_ps: I'll own perf. Ask them for a sanitized sample or we'll run a synthetic generator. Need p99 target; suggest proposing <150ms as a starting point.
anna_sales: I'll ask for sample + SLO. Finance: can we include a provisional 4-week POC quote + conversion credit option?
finance_zoe: Provisional stub: 2x A10 baseline + managed ops ~ $46k for a 4-week POC (provisional, subject to final sizing/discount/legal). Mark clearly as provisional.
sam_security: Security note: Hosted supports tenant key separation; Private supports HSM-backed keys via partner integrations (CloudHSM/YubiHSM) and requires a contract addendum. HSM only available on Private deployments. I'll prep the KMS/HSM appendix and questionnaire answers.
legal_lee: Don't claim FedRAMP authorization. Provide controls mapping and a FedRAMP-readiness plan if asked. For SOC2 we can share the current Type II for in-scope systems; for expanded scope provide interim attestations + timeline. Also include BAA requirement for PHI before any data transfer.
jordan_se: Capability matrix CSV draft (paste):

```
Feature,Hosted API,Dedicated Pools,Private (VPC/On-prem)
Text generation,Yes,Yes,Yes
Embeddings,Yes,Yes,Yes
Streaming chat,Limited,Yes,Yes
Private KMS,No,Yes,Yes
HSM-backed keys,No,Optional(Private),Partner integration req'd
SLA,Standard,Enhanced,Enterprise (negotiable)
Fallback policy,Region spill,Policy-driven failover,Policy-driven failover + notice
```

maria_ps: For the POC plan I'll propose: 2x A10 baseline, synthetic generator if needed, p99 target <150ms, and stress windows for 300 QPS bursts to validate autoscale and fallback.
anna_sales: Need a one-paragraph fallback example we can include in the RFI. @jordan_se can you draft?
jordan_se: Fallback paragraph: "Primary dedicated pool routes traffic. If sustained queueing (>80% node utilization for 2 minutes or median queue >5s) or error-rate spikes occur, traffic is routed to 1) reserved burst nodes, 2) a secondary dedicated pool in another region (if permitted), and 3) a smaller model variant for non-critical calls with client-visible response headers and rate-limit notifications. Console allows tuning of thresholds and automated alerts."
sam_security: I'll attach KMS appendix and flag legal caveats about HSM addenda and key rotation SOP. Also include our security questionnaire link.
finance_zoe: Add billing note: POC billed as a timeboxed upfront invoice; conversion to Reserved within 30 days gets applied credit toward the Reserved contract.
legal_lee: I'll add the SOC2 sharing paragraph and BAA language.
doc-bot: Uploaded: northpoint_rfi_bundle_v1.pdf -> https://files.redwood.internal/rfi/1778880000/northpoint_rfi_bundle_v1.pdf
anna_sales: Action items: 1) I'll request sample corpus + SLO from NorthPoint; 2) @maria_ps finalize perf plan; 3) @jordan_se finalize matrix + fallback copy; 4) @sam_security + @legal_lee prep KMS/HSM appendix and SOC2 notes; 5) @finance_zoe confirm provisional quote language. Please review here by 10am PT tomorrow.
